line_items.reasoning: Guidance called for flat to +2% YoY revenue including ~$570M of idiosyncratic headwinds; actual results absorbed $280M of those headwinds (USPS + international export) with no explicit statement that consolidated revenue came in above or below the flat-to-+2% range, suggesting results were roughly in line.

Reported adjusted EPS of $3.83 came in above the $3.70 midpoint of the guided $3.40–$4.00 range, and management explicitly noted it was above the midpoint of the Q1 outlook range despite incremental headwinds.

Federal Express adjusted operating margin expanded 70 bps YoY (beating the 'up modestly' guide), but FedEx Freight adjusted operating margin contracted 250 bps YoY, clearly missing the 'down modestly' guidance.
No Q1-specific CapEx deviation was reported; the FY'26 ~$4.5B CapEx plan appears to remain intact with no revision mentioned.

The $200M Q1 transformation savings target (DRIVE + Network 2.0) was not explicitly called out as exceeded or missed in the reported results, and the full-year ~$1B savings program appears on track, suggesting an inline outcome.
